edition_feature.image_alt: Edition 01 folio with brass anchor paperweight, wax seal, and fountain pen
edition_feature.body_1: Every Edition anchors to a place. Edition 01 anchors to the Strait of Gibraltar, where the Mediterranean meets the Atlantic. The accent is signal orange. The guest material is Hypalon. The allocation is fixed at 1,200 systems.
edition_feature.body_2: When Edition 01 closes, Edition 02 opens. Different place. Different accent. Different guest material. The system remains.

process.lede: We do not subcontract the bag and outsource the story. The system is specified by the office, made in a named atelier, and issued in a finite allocation. No middle layer.
process.step_01_copy: Every dossier ships with a printed spec sheet — fabric weight, stitch count, hardware tolerance. No undocumented choices. No proprietary screws.
process.step_02_copy: Cut, stitched, and twice-inspected by a fourteen-person atelier forty kilometres north of Porto. Ten units a day. Six days a week.
process.step_03_copy: Numbered, registered, and shipped from Porto in five business days. When the allocation closes, the Edition closes. We do not restock.

practitioners.heading:
Three named
practitioners.
practitioners.cristina_alt: Cristina Mendes at the Juki industrial machine in the Porto sample room
practitioners.cristina_bio: Fourteen years in soft-goods construction. Built the first Manifest Office prototype on a hotel-room ironing board in March 2024. Runs the QC bench. Signs every dossier.
practitioners.cristina_quote: "A bag should be repaired, not replaced. We design for the third decade."
practitioners.marc_alt: Marc Aubert inspecting an Anchor Latch with a jewelers loupe at the trims supplier
practitioners.marc_bio: A decade as a technical sales rep at a European trims supplier. Documents failure points on outdoor and commuter gear. Sourced every zip, every magnet, every paracord whip on the Edition 01 kit.
practitioners.marc_quote: "The zip is where most carry fails. Spend there. Save elsewhere."
practitioners.joana_alt: Joana Reis documenting a field test on a hotel desk in Mexico City
practitioners.joana_bio: Strategy consultant. Lisbon and Mexico City. Carried sample 7 through forty-three trips before we shipped Edition 01. Found the seam failure that triggered iteration 43.
practitioners.joana_quote: "The first version of anything is wrong. The forty-third is honest."

exploded_kit.lede: Seven pieces. One latch. The interactive viewer assembles the kit in your browser at sixty frames a second.

scroll_latch.beat_1_body: Brass, cold-forged in Porto. Hand-finished, lacquer-free.
scroll_latch.beat_2_body: A quarter-turn closes the case. No springs, no plastic.
scroll_latch.beat_3_body: O-ring tension keeps the slot screw seated through 2,400-mile rotations.
scroll_latch.beat_4_body: Field-serviceable with the blade of a coin.
scroll_latch.beat_5_body: Every component carries a serial. Every component is replaceable.
